sources.title: Design your EX30 (Volvo Cars Australia build page)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. EX30 Plus P5 Long Range Electric: Manufacturer's Recommended List Price (incl GST) $49,990 and Manufacturer's Recommended Drive Away Price $49,990 as displayed with no location entered (an estimate that varies with the device's postcode); version cards: EX30 From $49,990; EX30 Cross Country From $62,990. Banner: 'The fully electric EX30 from just $55,990 driveaway'. The page offers Request a quote and Book a Test Drive, not an order.
